newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends up after surge, cocoa down.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends up after surge, cocoa down.

text.p: COFFEE - Commission house buying, NY advance and lower US stocks propel prices higher. September ends $132 higher at $1,910.
COCOA - Changes direction after NY rally to new eight-year highs falters. September 11 stg lower at 1,112 stg.
SUGAR - Mostly lower with NY setting tone. Aug off 80 cents at $322.80 at 1603 GMT.
